name: SRIKANTH YADUGANI
title: ==QUALITY ASSURANCE LEAD==  |  TEST STRATEGY & DELIVERY

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Quality Assurance Lead== with 15+ years of experience spanning requirements analysis, test estimation, planning, execution, defect triage, regression and release coordination. Combines hands-on Selenium/Java/Cucumber automation with functional, integration, end-to-end and system testing, API testing with Postman, and SQL data validation. Experienced mentoring QA colleagues and coordinating cross-functional testing in financial services and retirement products.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Led and contributed to QA across the STLC, turning client and project requirements into test scenarios, cases, estimates and execution plans.
Planned in-sprint automation, prepared test data, executed tests, reported defects, retested fixes and published X-Ray execution results.
Automated sprint requirements with Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD; added completed scripts to the regression suite.
Enhanced automation frameworks and utilities for report validation, PDF comparison, file transfers and downloads, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter.
Validated report and database data with SQL Server Management Studio and PowerSelect, including XML and pipe-delimited data checks.
Ran weekly regression through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines, configured Jenkins jobs, and coordinated release builds and deployments.
Reviewed estimates and SOWs, identified delivery risks, prioritized testing with available capacity and mentored QA colleagues.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
roles.meta: 2015 - September 2026 | Project team: 9 | Retirement and financial communications
bullets: Supported document composition, data integration and delivery of personalized retirement and financial communications via print, email and online channels.
Used Selenium, Java, Cucumber, SQL, Postman, FTP, PDFBox, Maven and Axiom within the project automation and validation environment.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Analyzed requirements, prepared estimates and executed Waterfall testing across multiple environments.
Wrote and executed test cases, prioritized release support tickets, reproduced production issues and ran Selenium/QTP regression.
